title: Aeronautics and Space Report of the President: Fiscal Year 2024 — Phase 65 Space review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Space reporting pack. The FY 2024 report extends the single-year federal aerospace activity and historical appendix series. Publication lag and agency-specific methods must remain visible.
key_findings: The FY 2024 report extends the single-year federal aerospace activity and historical appendix series.
Method: Annual federal-department and agency reporting with historical launch and budget appendices.
Denominator: Federal aerospace activities and appendix measures included in the stated fiscal-year report.
Attribution: Federal department and agency reporting coordinated by NASA.
why_it_matters: Which records connect infrastructure and licensing to operator activity, missions, utilization, safety, and compatible repeat operations? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This observation adds one of three time points for the aeronautics and space report of the president series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for carrier, operator, and mission service outcomes.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Publication lag and agency-specific methods must remain visible.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Federal aerospace activities and appendix measures included in the stated fiscal-year report.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
